amenityHighlights: Two-level race car track at sea

cabinCategories.description: Norwegian Bliss interior stateroom with NCL's signature design and flexible Freestyle dining. Two lower beds convertible to queen.
Bright oceanview stateroom with large picture window — watch the Inside Passage scenery from your room.
Private balcony stateroom. Norwegian Bliss was built specifically for Alaska — the outdoor spaces are exceptional.
The Haven suite — a private ship-within-a-ship with its own pool, sundeck, restaurant, and 24-hour concierge service.

inclusions: All meals in main dining and Garden Café buffet

portsOfCall.description: Embarkation at Pier 66 (Bell Street Terminal). Norwegian Bliss — NCL's purpose-built Alaska flagship — departs for a 7-night voyage.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

portsOfCall.description: Alaska's scenic capital. Take a whale watching cruise in Auke Bay, trek to Mendenhall Glacier, or sample local king crab at Tracy's.
portsOfCall.name: Juneau, AK

portsOfCall.description: Gold Rush history meets spectacular mountain scenery. The White Pass & Yukon Route Railway offers unforgettable views above the treeline.
portsOfCall.name: Skagway, AK

portsOfCall.description: A full day of scenic cruising through Glacier Bay — one of Alaska's crown jewels. Watch tidewater glaciers calve massive ice into the sea.
portsOfCall.name: Glacier Bay National Park

portsOfCall.description: Rain capital of Alaska and totem pole capital of the world. Explore Creek Street, see the fish ladder, or take a floatplane tour of Misty Fjords.
portsOfCall.name: Ketchikan, AK

portsOfCall.description: An elegant evening arrival in Canada's most charming city. Visit Butchart Gardens or stroll the iconic Inner Harbour.
portsOfCall.name: Victoria, BC

reviewSnippet: Built with Alaska in mind — wraparound outdoor decks and a glass-walled Observation Lounge for scenic days, plus a race track and water slides — a top family pick with Freestyle (no fixed time) dining.

overrides.note: Arrival only — last 2026 Alaska cruise returns; the ship leaves empty for its Los Angeles winter season.
Arrival only — last 2027 Alaska cruise (Oct 9) returns; no Seattle departure is sold.
